notes.title: Crazy Steam Bros 2 free!
notes.content:
It's been five years since I published Crazy Steam Bros 2. Many things have happened since then, and I want to express my gratitude to all the people who bought the game at the time, as their support has helped me to continue developing games. 
Thinking about a possible "Crazy Steam Bros 3" in the long term, I think it's time to release the game for free for anyone who wants to have some fun with it. In 30 days it will be free.
If you want to know about my current projects, check out my [url=https://twitter.com/ArsCreativa]Twitter[/url] account.
Thanks a lot to all of you!

notes.title: "New" Old free bonus content
notes.content:
After an useful suggestion, I have added the original "Crazy Steam Bros 1" game, as a bonus for collectors.
You should find it in a folder of the local contents of the game. It's a Flash file, so you'll need a Flash player to run it.
Sadly, the  original files are corrupted, so I can't compile a fresh new version.
This is the same game that you still can find in some Flash game sites, so it has two drawbacks:
First, it tries to load an ad, and then it throws an error as it want to send some data to a no longer existing web direction.
Both drawbacks are skippable, and once the main menu is started, you'll can play without problems.
Have fun!

notes.title: v 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Hi again!

I have just updated v1.1 of Crazy Steam Bros 2:

- Fixed controls: Now they are more responsive.
- Fixed pause menu; There was a bug that allows to continue playing while displaying the options menu.
- Fixed ESC key: now the game will not close automatically when pressing the escape key.
- Leveled difficulty a bit.

If you encounter any problem with the game, don't hesitate to post it so I can try to fix it.

Linux bug whit scoreboards is still there. I'm waiting for an official reponse from GameMaker about it.

Last, I have uploaded new demo versions of the game. I'll publish them at Steam soon, but at this time you can download them from [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/crazy-steam-bros-2/downloads] IndieDB[/url], so you can try the game before buying it.

Bye!

notes.title: About controls complaints.
notes.content:
Hi. I'm sorry that some users doesn't like the control style of the game. I'm planning to release an update ASAP making the controls more fast and precise.

There's a bug on Linux that prevent the scores to get uploaded to Steam's servers. Sadly, this is a third part bug, and I'm trying to get a solution.

The only thing that I can't change is the game itself. You can like it, or don't, but the game is what it is. It's not a port of a mobile game, and is designed from a starting point as the same game for all the platforms that can run it. It doesn't pretend to be the ultimate shmup, just a fun and entertaining game. 

If you want to try it, there are free downloadable demos available here:
[url=http://www.indiedb.com/members/arscreativa/downloads]http://www.indiedb.com/members/arscreativa/downloads[/url]
You can download it and decide by yourself if you like it or not before buying it.

I'll upload also a demo with the updated controls when ready, at IndieDB page and here at Steam.

I am sorry that some of you have not liked the game, but I will remain consistent with my idea about game development, that is to create games that I like to play. And I really enjoy playing Crazy Steam Bros.

Thanks to you all!
